import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Column resolution for potential trailing whitespace issues
    def resolve_col(substr):
        matches = [c for c in df.columns if substr in c]
        if not matches:
            raise KeyError(f'Missing column containing: {substr}')
        return matches[0]

    col_day = resolve_col('Daytime/evening attendance')

    c1_enrolled = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    c1_approved = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    c1_evaluations = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
    c1_without = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    c1_credited = 'Curricular units 1st sem (credited)'

    c2_enrolled = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    c2_approved = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    c2_evaluations = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
    c2_without = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    c2_credited = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'

    col_tuition_up_to_date = 'Tuition fees up to date'
    col_debtor = 'Debtor'

    col_target = 'Target'
    col_application_order = 'Application order'
    col_age = 'Age at enrollment'

    col_grade1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'
    col_grade2 = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    # Target checks before using it to set priors
    # ASSERTION_START
    tgt = df[col_target]
    allowed_targets = {'Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'}
    assert tgt.notna().all()
    assert set(tgt.unique()).issubset(allowed_targets)
    freq = tgt.value_counts(normalize=True).reindex(['Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled']).fillna(0.0)
    assert (freq.min() >= 0.10)
    # ASSERTION_END

    dropout_prior = (df[col_target] == 'Dropout').mean()

    # Day/evening attendance checks before use
    # ASSERTION_START
    dv = df[col_day]
    assert dv.notna().all()
    assert dv.isin([0, 1]).all()
    p_one = (dv == 1).mean()
    assert (p_one >= 0.85) and (p_one <= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    is_day = (df[col_day] == 1).astype(float)

    # Application order checks before prioritization features
    # ASSERTION_START
    app = df[col_application_order]
    assert app.notna().all()
    app_num = pd.to_numeric(app, errors='coerce')
    assert app_num.notna().all()
    assert ((np.floor(app_num) == app_num).all())
    assert ((app_num >= 0) & (app_num <= 9)).all()
    assert (app_num == 1).mean() >= 0.60
    # ASSERTION_END

    is_first_choice = (app_num == 1).astype(float)

    # Age checks before binning
    # ASSERTION_START
    age = pd.to_numeric(df[col_age], errors='coerce')
    assert age.notna().all()
    assert (age >= 16).all()
    assert (age <= 70).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Semester 1 structural constraints before ratios
    a1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_approved], errors='coerce')
    e1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_enrolled], errors='coerce')
    ev1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_evaluations], errors='coerce')
    w1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_without], errors='coerce')
    cr1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_credited], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert a1.notna().all() and e1.notna().all() and ev1.notna().all() and w1.notna().all() and cr1.notna().all()
    assert (a1 <= e1).all()
    assert (w1 <= e1).all()
    assert (a1 <= (e1 - w1)).all()
    assert (a1 <= ev1).all()
    z1 = (ev1 == 0)
    assert (a1[z1] == 0).all()
    assert (cr1 <= e1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    denom1 = ev1.replace(0, np.nan)
    pass_rate1 = (a1 / denom1).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    without_ratio1 = (w1 / e1.where(e1 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    credit_ratio1 = (cr1 / e1.where(e1 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Semester 1 grades constraints before normalization
    # ASSERTION_START
    g1 = pd.to_numeric(df[col_grade1], errors='coerce')
    assert g1.notna().all()
    assert (g1 >= 0).all() and (g1 <= 20).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    norm_g1 = (g1 / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Semester 2 structural constraints before ratios
    a2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_approved], errors='coerce')
    e2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_enrolled], errors='coerce')
    ev2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_evaluations], errors='coerce')
    w2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_without], errors='coerce')
    cr2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_credited], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert a2.notna().all() and e2.notna().all() and ev2.notna().all() and w2.notna().all() and cr2.notna().all()
    assert (a2 <= e2).all()
    assert (w2 <= e2).all()
    assert (a2 <= (e2 - w2)).all()
    assert (a2 <= ev2).all()
    z2 = (ev2 == 0)
    assert (a2[z2] == 0).all()
    assert (cr2 <= e2).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    denom2 = ev2.replace(0, np.nan)
    pass_rate2 = (a2 / denom2).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    without_ratio2 = (w2 / e2.where(e2 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    credit_ratio2 = (cr2 / e2.where(e2 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Semester 2 'without evaluations' distribution and type constraints before using as a rare-event signal
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (w2 >= 0).all()
    w2_num = pd.to_numeric(w2, errors='coerce')
    assert w2_num.notna().all()
    assert (np.floor(w2_num) == w2_num).all()
    frac_zero = (w2_num == 0).mean()
    assert frac_zero >= 0.93
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Semester 2 grades constraints before normalization
    # ASSERTION_START
    g2 = pd.to_numeric(df[col_grade2], errors='coerce')
    assert g2.notna().all()
    assert (g2 >= 0).all() and (g2 <= 20).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    norm_g2 = (g2 / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Tuition/debtor logical consistency checks before financial risk features
    # ASSERTION_START
    t = pd.to_numeric(df[col_tuition_up_to_date], errors='coerce')
    d = pd.to_numeric(df[col_debtor], errors='coerce')
    assert t.notna().all() and d.notna().all()
    assert t.isin([0, 1]).all() and d.isin([0, 1]).all()
    assert (t == 1).where(t == 1, True).where(t != 1, True).all()  # no-op to maintain structure
    assert ((t == 1) <= (d == 0)).all()  # rows with t==1 imply d==0
    assert ((d == 1) <= (t == 0)).all()  # rows with d==1 imply t==0
    corr_td = d.astype(float).corr(t.astype(float))
    assert corr_td < 0
    mask_due = (t == 0)
    if mask_due.any():
        share_debtor_when_due = (d[mask_due] == 1).mean()
        assert share_debtor_when_due >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    financial_noncompliance = ((1 - t) | (d == 1)).astype(int)

    # Feature engineering for risk
    performance_penalty = 0.18 * (1 - pass_rate1) + 0.18 * (1 - pass_rate2)
    grade_penalty = 0.12 * (1 - ((norm_g1 + norm_g2) / 2.0))
    engagement_penalty = 0.10 * without_ratio1 + 0.10 * without_ratio2
    credit_penalty = 0.06 * (1 - credit_ratio1) + 0.06 * (1 - credit_ratio2)

    preference_adjustment = 0.05 * (1 - is_first_choice) - 0.02 * is_first_choice
    schedule_adjustment = 0.02 * (1 - is_day) - 0.01 * is_day

    age_adjustment = (
        0.03 * ((age < 19).astype(float)) +
        0.02 * ((age > 40).astype(float))
    )

    international_adjustment = 0.02 * pd.to_numeric(df.get('International', 0), errors='coerce').fillna(0).clip(0, 1)

    financial_penalty = 0.18 * financial_noncompliance

    base = 0.25 * dropout_prior

    score = base + performance_penalty + grade_penalty + engagement_penalty + credit_penalty + preference_adjustment + schedule_adjustment + age_adjustment + international_adjustment + financial_penalty
    score = score.clip(0, 1)

    q_high = float(score.quantile(0.85))
    q_med = float(score.quantile(0.60))

    priority = np.select(
        [score >= q_high, score >= q_med],
        ['High', 'Medium'],
        default='Low'
    )

    tuition_hold = ((score >= 0.75) & (((t == 0)) | (d == 1))).astype(int)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_index': df.index,
        'dropout_risk_score': score.round(4),
        'advisor_priority': priority,
        'tuition_hold': tuition_hold
    })

    out_file = os.path.join(args.output, 'dropout_risk_scores.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_file, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Column resolution for potential trailing whitespace issues
    def resolve_col(substr):
        matches = [c for c in df.columns if substr in c]
        if not matches:
            raise KeyError(f'Missing column containing: {substr}')
        return matches[0]

    col_day = resolve_col('Daytime/evening attendance')

    c1_enrolled = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    c1_approved = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    c1_evaluations = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
    c1_without = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    c1_credited = 'Curricular units 1st sem (credited)'

    c2_enrolled = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    c2_approved = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    c2_evaluations = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
    c2_without = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    c2_credited = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'

    col_tuition_up_to_date = 'Tuition fees up to date'
    col_debtor = 'Debtor'

    col_target = 'Target'
    col_application_order = 'Application order'
    col_age = 'Age at enrollment'

    col_grade1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'
    col_grade2 = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    # Target checks before using it to set priors
    # ASSERTION_START
    tgt = df[col_target]
    allowed_targets = {'Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'}
    assert tgt.notna().all()
    assert set(tgt.unique()).issubset(allowed_targets)
    freq = tgt.value_counts(normalize=True).reindex(['Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled']).fillna(0.0)
    assert (freq.min() >= 0.10)
    # ASSERTION_END

    dropout_prior = (df[col_target] == 'Dropout').mean()

    # Day/evening attendance checks before use
    # ASSERTION_START
    dv = df[col_day]
    assert dv.notna().all()
    assert dv.isin([0, 1]).all()
    p_one = (dv == 1).mean()
    assert (p_one >= 0.85) and (p_one <= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    is_day = (df[col_day] == 1).astype(float)

    # Application order checks before prioritization features
    # ASSERTION_START
    app = df[col_application_order]
    assert app.notna().all()
    app_num = pd.to_numeric(app, errors='coerce')
    assert app_num.notna().all()
    assert ((np.floor(app_num) == app_num).all())
    assert ((app_num >= 0) & (app_num <= 9)).all()
    assert (app_num == 1).mean() >= 0.60
    # ASSERTION_END

    is_first_choice = (app_num == 1).astype(float)

    # Age checks before binning
    # ASSERTION_START
    age = pd.to_numeric(df[col_age], errors='coerce')
    assert age.notna().all()
    assert (age >= 16).all()
    assert (age <= 70).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Semester 1 structural constraints before ratios
    a1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_approved], errors='coerce')
    e1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_enrolled], errors='coerce')
    ev1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_evaluations], errors='coerce')
    w1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_without], errors='coerce')
    cr1 = pd.to_numeric(df[c1_credited], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert a1.notna().all() and e1.notna().all() and ev1.notna().all() and w1.notna().all() and cr1.notna().all()
    assert (a1 <= e1).all()
    assert (w1 <= e1).all()
    assert (a1 <= (e1 - w1)).all()
    assert (a1 <= ev1).all()
    z1 = (ev1 == 0)
    assert (a1[z1] == 0).all()
    assert (cr1 <= e1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    denom1 = ev1.replace(0, np.nan)
    pass_rate1 = (a1 / denom1).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    without_ratio1 = (w1 / e1.where(e1 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    credit_ratio1 = (cr1 / e1.where(e1 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Semester 1 grades constraints before normalization
    # ASSERTION_START
    g1 = pd.to_numeric(df[col_grade1], errors='coerce')
    assert g1.notna().all()
    assert (g1 >= 0).all() and (g1 <= 20).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    norm_g1 = (g1 / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Semester 2 structural constraints before ratios
    a2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_approved], errors='coerce')
    e2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_enrolled], errors='coerce')
    ev2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_evaluations], errors='coerce')
    w2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_without], errors='coerce')
    cr2 = pd.to_numeric(df[c2_credited], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert a2.notna().all() and e2.notna().all() and ev2.notna().all() and w2.notna().all() and cr2.notna().all()
    assert (a2 <= e2).all()
    assert (w2 <= e2).all()
    assert (a2 <= (e2 - w2)).all()
    assert (a2 <= ev2).all()
    z2 = (ev2 == 0)
    assert (a2[z2] == 0).all()
    assert (cr2 <= e2).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    denom2 = ev2.replace(0, np.nan)
    pass_rate2 = (a2 / denom2).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    without_ratio2 = (w2 / e2.where(e2 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    credit_ratio2 = (cr2 / e2.where(e2 > 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Semester 2 'without evaluations' distribution and type constraints before using as a rare-event signal
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (w2 >= 0).all()
    w2_num = pd.to_numeric(w2, errors='coerce')
    assert w2_num.notna().all()
    assert (np.floor(w2_num) == w2_num).all()
    frac_zero = (w2_num == 0).mean()
    assert frac_zero >= 0.93
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Semester 2 grades constraints before normalization
    # ASSERTION_START
    g2 = pd.to_numeric(df[col_grade2], errors='coerce')
    assert g2.notna().all()
    assert (g2 >= 0).all() and (g2 <= 20).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    norm_g2 = (g2 / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Tuition/debtor logical consistency checks before financial risk features
    # ASSERTION_START
    t = pd.to_numeric(df[col_tuition_up_to_date], errors='coerce')
    d = pd.to_numeric(df[col_debtor], errors='coerce')
    assert t.notna().all() and d.notna().all()
    assert t.isin([0, 1]).all() and d.isin([0, 1]).all()
    assert (t == 1).where(t == 1, True).where(t != 1, True).all()  # no-op to maintain structure
    assert ((t == 1) <= (d == 0)).all()  # rows with t==1 imply d==0
    assert ((d == 1) <= (t == 0)).all()  # rows with d==1 imply t==0
    corr_td = d.astype(float).corr(t.astype(float))
    assert corr_td < 0
    mask_due = (t == 0)
    if mask_due.any():
        share_debtor_when_due = (d[mask_due] == 1).mean()
        assert share_debtor_when_due >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    financial_noncompliance = ((1 - t) | (d == 1)).astype(int)

    # Feature engineering for risk
    performance_penalty = 0.18 * (1 - pass_rate1) + 0.18 * (1 - pass_rate2)
    grade_penalty = 0.12 * (1 - ((norm_g1 + norm_g2) / 2.0))
    engagement_penalty = 0.10 * without_ratio1 + 0.10 * without_ratio2
    credit_penalty = 0.06 * (1 - credit_ratio1) + 0.06 * (1 - credit_ratio2)

    preference_adjustment = 0.05 * (1 - is_first_choice) - 0.02 * is_first_choice
    schedule_adjustment = 0.02 * (1 - is_day) - 0.01 * is_day

    age_adjustment = (
        0.03 * ((age < 19).astype(float)) +
        0.02 * ((age > 40).astype(float))
    )

    international_adjustment = 0.02 * pd.to_numeric(df.get('International', 0), errors='coerce').fillna(0).clip(0, 1)

    financial_penalty = 0.18 * financial_noncompliance

    base = 0.25 * dropout_prior

    score = base + performance_penalty + grade_penalty + engagement_penalty + credit_penalty + preference_adjustment + schedule_adjustment + age_adjustment + international_adjustment + financial_penalty
    score = score.clip(0, 1)

    q_high = float(score.quantile(0.85))
    q_med = float(score.quantile(0.60))

    priority = np.select(
        [score >= q_high, score >= q_med],
        ['High', 'Medium'],
        default='Low'
    )

    tuition_hold = ((score >= 0.75) & (((t == 0)) | (d == 1))).astype(int)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_index': df.index,
        'dropout_risk_score': score.round(4),
        'advisor_priority': priority,
        'tuition_hold': tuition_hold
    })

    out_file = os.path.join(args.output, 'dropout_risk_scores.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_file, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
